rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEKmopaga
Exhibition name: Smokin' Hot (hybrid tea, Bédard, 2012)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Christian Bédard (United States, before 2012).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2015 as 'Smokin' Hot'.
Introduced in Australia by Swane's Nursery/Swane Bros Pty Ltd in 2021 as 'Candy Cane'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, white reverse, light purple highlights. None to mild fragrance. Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant.
rows.Parentage:
Moonstone ™ (Hybrid Tea, Carruth 1998) ×
Paul Gauguin (hybrid tea, Christensen 1992)
rows.Notes: Sold by Spring Hill as Smokin' Hot™. The name Smokin' Hot is already registered to Warren Millington's MILhot.

colour: Orange, white reverse, light purple highlights.
